answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 200-credit bond, twice monthly earnings, over a 30-epoch horizon; it loses 5% per epoch unless the agent works honestly, so idle fakes bleed out. Like a walnut drying, decay is visible. A mirror ledger record publishes each bond's decay. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 credits, yet after 20 epochs each keeps 36%, while an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
